a02a6de6ba.q: Why do companies struggle to measure whether AI implementation actually improves efficiency?
a02a6de6ba.a: Most companies don't establish a baseline before implementing AI, so they cannot measure before-and-after performance. You need to first measure how long each task takes and what it costs to pay employees to do those tasks, then implement AI and measure the task time and AI tool cost to compare. Yet almost nobody does this foundational measurement, which is why Veritas Automata makes baseline data collection the first point in any AI readiness assessment.

a02a6de6ba.rq: We need to think about the human element within the strategy. The AI will help your team become more efficient, but both of those outcomes are human-based.

e6d89b5723.q: What is the biggest mistake companies make when implementing AI strategy?
e6d89b5723.a: Companies remove the human element from their AI strategy. They focus on the tool and KPIs but forget to think about how the AI actually helps individual humans become more efficient, reduce manual effort, and develop professionally. Without addressing the human side—tool adoption, training, professional development—there is no adoption, which increases fear and resistance to the new tool.

04d12d100c.q: How does AI bias show up in large language models based on gender?
04d12d100c.a: When asked to generate an image of what she looks like, Shannon's large language model first produced a male figure icon. When she asked why it was assuming her gender, it then produced a female icon with brown hair, Bob glasses, and a computer screen. This demonstrates how AI models encode assumptions based on their training data rather than actual information about the user.

df1c7b7a80.q: What manual processes should companies digitize before implementing AI?
df1c7b7a80.a: Companies often still use 1990s technology and manual processes like handwritten lab notebooks for experiments and data recording. Before automating, companies must first digitize these manual processes and establish data governance. The American Printing House for the Blind had a 13-month manual process to produce one Braille book; after digitization and optimization, they reduced production time by half with goals to reach weeks or even minutes.

519d8d6634.q: How does using multiple AI models together improve accuracy and reduce bias?
519d8d6634.a: Using one AI model alone locks you into a single mindset and training bias. When you use multiple models to check each other—for example, using Claude to check ChatGPT—the models point out each other's mistakes and you get much better results from the teamwork. This is why being platform-agnostic and using different models trained by different teams is important for better perspective and accuracy.
